description: Upload a local image, video, or audio file to BudgetPixel and get back a short-lived URL (valid ~24h) to use as a generation input: pass it as an input_images value on generate_image, or as image / end_image / reference_images / video / audio on generate_video. Use this when the user has a LOCAL file: read the file and pass its base64 as 'file'. Not charged; max 50MB. Video/audio inputs REQUIRE this (generate_video takes them by URL only). If you already have a public URL, pass it straight to the generate tool instead.

file.description: The file to upload, as raw base64 or a data URI (data:image/png;base64,...). Read the local file and pass its base64 here. Max 50MB. Images: PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF · Video: MP4/WebM · Audio: MP3/WAV/OGG.

name: upload_media
title: Upload Media
